about: Chrome source rules (ext/rules) that the Safari build leaves out, for licence reasons (H-LICENSE-REVIEW §7.2). Applied by safari/tools/safari-rules.mjs, point 4 of its header. domains: exact hosts, dropped wherever they appear (a requestDomains entry, its siblings survive; or a ||host^ urlFilter). urlFilters: the source rule with exactly that urlFilter. ids: a whole source rule. Only block rules; every entry must match something or the build fails; ext/rules is never edited from here. Reasons go in notes, keyed by the entry text. This file never ships.

notes.sascdn.com: Qualified for Nullecho only through DuckDuckGo Tracker Radar (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); no EasyList/EasyPrivacy/AdGuard whole-host rule (H-LICENSE-REVIEW §2.2). Excluded from the App Store build, which takes optional tips, until DuckDuckGo answers or first-hand evidence is recorded.
